name: Liraglutide
mechanism: GLP-1 analogue increasing insulin secretion and reducing appetite
dosing: Titrated subcutaneously per product regimen; doses vary by indication
contraindications: Personal/family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC), MEN2
interactions: May delay gastric emptying affecting absorption of oral meds
clinicalPearls: Useful for weight loss and glycaemic control; specialist initiation often
indication: Type 2 diabetes; weight management in some licensed indications
